family.tagline: Two toddlers, one shelf, and a parcel that arrived on a Tuesday.
family.story: Tomasz is a portrait photographer. Priya is an operations consultant. Both work from home, in a white house by the canal. Their clients' files sit on one Companion Core.

companion.name: Bram
companion.job: Opens Twenty and other web pages in its own browser and fills in the forms Tomasz asks for.
companion.limits: One task at a time. Tomasz checks every result.

companion.name: Sunita
companion.job: Drafts replies and answers questions for Priya's clients, using the context she connected.
companion.limits: Drafts only. Priya reads and sends every message.

popup.title: A parcel at the door
popup.body: A parcel waits at the Nowak-Pillai front door. Tomasz carries it through the dining room to the study, where Priya clears a space on the desk.

popup.title: Unbox the Companion Core
popup.body: Inside: the Companion Core, a power cable, a quick-start guide and a recovery USB drive. The Core's footprint is about three quarters of a sheet of paper.

popup.title: Plug it in
popup.body: Priya plugs in the power cable and presses the button. The Core wakes and opens its own Wi-Fi network.

popup.title: Join it from a phone
popup.body: Tomasz opens the Wi-Fi settings on his phone and joins the Core's own network. Then he chooses the home network from the list.

popup.title: Pick your first agents and apps
popup.body: In Companion Hub, Priya picks Hermes, Tomasz picks OpenClaw, and they add Immich and Nextcloud. Companion Memory (beta) comes along. Then they walk away.

beats.capability: an agent that connects to chat apps, email and more from one self-hosted app

popup.title: Sunita says hello
popup.body: Priya messages the agent she named Sunita. Sunita answers, and the Core is running.
popup.note: Messages pass through the chat service you choose.

say.speaker: mika
say.text: Hello, Priya. I am Sunita. What should we do first?

beats.capability: back up, search and organise your family photos and videos

popup.title: Photos land on the Core
popup.body: Tomasz backs up the weekend's photos to Immich from the couch. They land on the Core, ready to search and organize.

beats.capability: stream your own movies, shows and music to every screen in the house

popup.title: Film night, from the Core
popup.body: Friday is film night. Jellyfin streams Priya's own collection of movies to the living-room TV, straight from the Core.

beats.capability: control and automate your smart home from one place, locally

popup.title: Lights on a schedule
popup.body: At ten, the living-room lights dim on a Home Assistant schedule. It runs on the Core and reaches the lights over the home Wi-Fi.

beats.capability: a shared grocery list, recipe book, meal planner

popup.title: One list, two phones
popup.body: Tomasz and Priya share the grocery list in KitchenOwl. Oat milk added at the counter shows up on the other's phone.

beats.capability: a shared grocery list, recipe book, meal planner

popup.title: Grandma's soup, kept
popup.body: Tomasz types his grandmother's soup recipe into KitchenOwl once. Now it sits in the family recipe book, beside the meal planner.

beats.capability: a password vault you host that works with the Bitwarden apps

popup.title: Passwords stay in the house
popup.body: Priya opens VaultWarden, the password vault for the household. It works with the Bitwarden apps, and the vault itself lives on the Core.

beats.capability: your files, calendar and contacts on your own Core, synced to your devices

popup.title: One calendar for both of them
popup.body: Shoots and client calls land in one Nextcloud calendar. Priya and Tomasz see the same week on their phones.

beats.capability: a local video recorder with object detection for your IP cameras

popup.title: The drive, recorded at home
popup.body: An IP camera on the drive streams to Frigate. The recordings stay on the Core, and the clips play on the home network.

beats.capability: track your plants, watering and care history across rooms and beds, with photos and a garden journal

popup.title: The new hedge has a journal
popup.body: Priya logs the new hedge in HortusFox. She notes where it grows, when she watered it, and adds a photo for the journal.

beats.capability: stream your own music collection to any device

popup.title: Music by the pool
popup.body: Tomasz plays his own music collection from Navidrome on the patio. It streams from the Core to his phone.

popup.title: One Core, a whole household
popup.body: Photos, paperwork, lights, cameras and two agents. The Nowak-Pillai household runs it all from one Companion Core in the study.

closing.body: Your photos, your paperwork and your agents can run on a Companion Core at home. Browse the Companion Hub store and pick your first apps.

notes: Exemplar written by the showrunner. FTUE beats follow the owner's hotspot flow (STORY-BIBLE section 8); owner sign-off against the fact sheet is open.
ftue-hello and office-reply show Hermes over a chat service; the disclosure note is on the first Hermes beat.
garden-cameras assumes the family owns an IP camera: it is not in the Core box and not in the 3D scene.
